definitions.explanation: In a dignified, confident, and impressive manner. Describes acting without hesitation or shame, or having an imposing and majestic presence.

examples.japanese: {堂々|どうどう}と⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{堂々|どうどう}と⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していない→する：00392_suru⟧なら、{堂々|どうどう}と⟦していれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: If you haven't done anything wrong, just hold your head high.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {堂々|どうどう}と⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: to walk confidently
- {堂々|どうどう}と⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak with confidence
- {堂々|どうどう}と⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: to be composed and dignified
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧たる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an imposing/dignified attitude

USAGE:
{堂々|どうどう}と is generally positive, suggesting dignity and self-assurance. However, it can carry an ironic or negative nuance when someone acts brazenly despite doing something wrong (e.g., {堂々|どうどう}とウソ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく, to lie brazenly).

RELATED FORM:
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧たる〜: an imposing/magnificent ~ (literary attributive form)
